body:
~14T param, 114 layers, hybrid GDN/MLA, MoE (1,224 experts, top-48 + 1 shared), NVFP4. Internal codename numbat, Anthropic's next Mythos-class training run. numbat is the codename referenced in the Claude Code source leak (Mar 2026).

## Ficha rápida

- burner22/numbat
- 6849B parámetros
- VRAM mínima estimada 16438.8 GB (Multi-GPU / servidor)
- 159 likes en Hugging Face

## Descripción original

~14T param, 114 layers, hybrid GDN/MLA, MoE (1,224 experts, top-48 + 1 shared), NVFP4. Internal codename numbat, Anthropic's next Mythos-class training run. numbat is the codename referenced in the Claude Code source leak (Mar 2026). This is a checkpoint from that training run, pulled mid-pretraining.

The 772 shards total ~7.72 TB of tensor data. Each shard is safetensors format, under 10.6 GB per file.

configurationnumbat.py and modelingnumbat.py are included: a complete reference implementation of the checkpoint. Its module tree has an exact slot for every tensor in every shard, so the full checkpoint loads with loadstatedict(strict=True) (and, since the classes derive from PreTrainedModel, also via AutoModelForCausalLM.frompretrained(..., trustremotecode=True)). NumbatForCausalLM.forward runs the trunk and NumbatForCausalLM.draft runs the MTP layer.

- numbat was confirmed as a codename for an unreleased Anthropic model in the Claude Code source leak (March 2026), found in a comment in prompts.ts: "Remove this section when we launch numbat." - The checkpoint's architecture (hybrid GDN/MLA, 1,224 experts, NVFP4) matches what would be expected of a next-generation Mythos-class training run - Every tensor in every shard is internally consistent: E4M3 scale blocks decode their E2M1 payloads within RTNE bounds, block scales never underflow, and every NVFP4 quad round-trips exactly - File sizes, tensor counts, and index entries are all determini…
